dora_applied.note: DORA State of AI-assisted Software Development 2025 cited as an industry survey.

space_applied.note: Only the cited paper 'The SPACE of AI' (Houck et al.); SPACE itself is not discussed.

ai_discussed.note: Perceived effects of AI coding assistants are the topic.

remote_covid.note: Neither mentions remote work or COVID-19.

data_window.value: October 2024–April 2025 (two questionnaire waves, October 2024 and April 2025)

cat_productivity.note: Productivity is only perceived (single Likert item, goes to survey); task completion time and completed tasks are cited from literature.

cat_quality.note: Borderline: only a ranking of concerns (quality, maintainability, security), not a quality measure.

cat_collaboration.note: Borderline: 'reviewing code' is a perceived task-time item framed as verification of AI output; full text also has a qualitative sub-theme on team trust and code review effort (p. 21).

cat_satisfaction.note: Developer experience is measured with the DevEx framework (goes to cat_devex); attitudes toward AI tools are not satisfaction measures.

cat_activity.note: Commits and PRs only cited from other studies.

cat_delivery.note: PR cycle time only cited from literature.

cat_devex.note: DevEx dimensions (feedback loops, cognitive load, flow state) rated per participant at both waves.

cat_survey.note: Two Qualtrics questionnaires with Likert items and open-ended responses.

evidence.quote: Through a longitudinal mixed-methods investigation, we examined how professional software engineers perceive the effects of AI coding assistants in regard to task focus, developer experience, and
The first questionnaire (Q1) was administered in October 2024 and the second (Q2) in April 2025, each open for four weeks.
Both questionnaires were administered online through Qualtrics, enabling us to reach professional software engineers globally.
Participants rated their perceived productivity change and the impact of AI coding assistants on each of the three DevEx dimensions [33]: cognitive load, feedback loops, and flow state.
